class TestExecutionResult:
def test_success_detection(self):
r = ExecutionResult(exit_code=0, timed_out=False)
assert r.success is True
def test_failure_detection(self):
r = ExecutionResult(exit_code=1, timed_out=False)
assert r.success is False
def test_timeout_is_failure(self):
r = ExecutionResult(exit_code=0, timed_out=True)
assert r.success is False
def test_task_complete_detection(self):
r = ExecutionResult(stdout="TASK_COMPLETE: todo listo")
assert r.task_complete is True
assert r.task_result == "todo listo"
def test_no_task_complete(self):
r = ExecutionResult(stdout="resultado normal")
assert r.task_complete is False
assert r.task_result is None

assert r.has_screenshot is True

head: Carter OS — VRAM Manager
Gestion inteligente de VRAM para proteger rendimiento de juegos.
Idea rescatada del proyecto anterior: estados HOT/WARM/COLD.
Implementacion minima pero funcional sobre Ollama.
HOT  = Modelo cargado en VRAM (inferencia inmediata)
WARM = Modelo en RAM del sistema (Ollama lo descargo de GPU)
COLD = Modelo descargado completamente
